meta.title: Wanted Level: GTA 6 launch nights in Antwerp
meta.description: No console on launch night? Find a GTA 6 launch night at a bar, gaming café or student room in Antwerp, RSVP and play together.

footer.label: Footer
footer.about: Wanted Level is a free, non-commercial community project from Antwerp.
footer.nonAffiliation: Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. GTA 6 is mentioned only to describe what people play at these meetups.

home.headline: No console on launch night? Play GTA 6 together.
home.lead: GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox only. Find a launch night at a bar, gaming café or student room near you, grab a spot and play with people instead of alone.

safety.label: How we keep meetups safe
safety.publicVenues: Public venues only: bars, gaming cafés and student rooms. Never private homes.
safety.reviewed: Every organizer and every event is checked by a person before it goes live.
safety.reportInstantly: Something feels off? Report it. A safety report hides the event right away.

Good news: your application to host launch nights as {name} was approved.

You can now add your venue and create events. Every event is checked once more before it goes live.

applicationRejected.body: Thanks for applying to host as {name}. We can't approve the application at this point.

eventPublished.body: "{title}" is now public on the Wanted Level map and people can RSVP.

eventRejected.subject: Your event wasn't approved: {title}
eventRejected.body: "{title}" wasn't published. You can edit it and send it in again.

eventRemoved.body: A moderator removed "{title}" from Wanted Level. People who RSVPed were told it's off.

postRestored.body: Your post on the group board of "{title}" is visible again.

userBanned.subject: Your Wanted Level account is suspended
userBanned.body:
Your account can no longer RSVP, post, report or host events, and your upcoming RSVPs were cancelled.

You can still log in to see your data or delete your account. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this email.

userUnbanned.subject: Your Wanted Level account is active again
userUnbanned.body: Your account is no longer suspended. Welcome back.

venueVerified.subject: Your venue is verified: {title}
venueVerified.body: "{title}" now shows a verified badge on its events.

venueUnverified.subject: Verified badge removed: {title}
venueUnverified.body: "{title}" no longer shows a verified badge.

eventCancelledAttendee.subject: Cancelled: {title}
eventCancelledAttendee.body: The organizer cancelled "{title}", which you RSVPed to. Sorry! Other launch nights may still have spots.

eventRemovedAttendee.subject: Off: {title}
eventRemovedAttendee.body: "{title}", which you RSVPed to, was taken down by our moderators. Please don't go to the venue for this event.

accountDeleted.subject: Your Wanted Level account is deleted
accountDeleted.body:
As you asked, we deleted your account and everything linked to it: your profile, date of birth, RSVPs and group posts.

This is the last email you'll get from us.

eventPage.rsvpDone: You're in! See you there. Add it to your calendar so you don't forget.

board.noteHint: Up to 280 characters. No phone numbers or addresses.
board.discordHint: Only people going to this event will see it. Leave empty to stay private.
board.error: That didn't work. Check that you're still going and try again.
board.invalid: Check your note (1 to 280 characters) and Discord username (letters, numbers, dots and underscores).

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: Free, and it takes a minute. We email you a link, no password needed.
signup.displayNameHint: Shown on group boards to people going to the same event. A nickname is fine.
signup.dateOfBirthHint: Only used to check age limits. Nobody else sees it.
signup.legal: By creating an account you agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms>. Read how we handle your data in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
signup.under13Title: Sorry, you need to be at least 13.
signup.under13Body: In Belgium you can create an account like this yourself from age 13. We didn't save anything you entered. Ask a parent about events for all ages!

login.title: Log in
login.lead: Enter your email and we'll send you a login link. No password needed.
login.linkError: That login link didn't work. It may have expired or been used already. Ask for a new one below.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.signupBody: We sent you an email with a link to confirm your account. Tap it on this device or any other.
checkEmail.loginBody: If there's an account for that address, we just sent it a login link. Tap it to log in.
checkEmail.tipSpam: Nothing after a couple of minutes? Check your spam or promotions folder.
checkEmail.tipExpiry: The link works once and expires after an hour.
checkEmail.tipNoAccount: No email at all? You might not have an account yet.

confirm.title: Almost there
confirm.lead: Tap the button to finish logging in to Wanted Level.

report.title: Report
report.lead: Tell us what's wrong. Moderators read every report, and the person you report won't see who reported them.
report.emergency: Is someone in danger right now? Call

safety.label: Safety
safety.hint: Someone could get hurt, feels unsafe, or a private address is involved. We hide it right away until we've checked.

spam.label: Spam
spam.hint: Ads, scams or nothing to do with a launch night.

wrong_info.label: Wrong info
wrong_info.hint: Wrong time, place, age limit or the event isn't happening.

other.label: Something else
other.hint: Anything else that breaks the rules.

report.detailsHint: Up to 1000 characters. Details help us act faster.

reportThanks.title: Thanks for reporting
reportThanks.hidden: We hid it right away. A moderator will look at it as soon as possible.
reportThanks.received: A moderator will look at it as soon as possible.
reportThanks.next: If we take action, the person responsible hears what was removed and why. We don't tell them who reported it.
reportThanks.emergency: If someone is in danger right now, call

apply.title: Host a launch night
apply.lead: Run a bar, café, gaming café or student association room in Antwerp? Tell us who you are. A person checks every application.
apply.ruleVenue: Public venues only, never a private home.
apply.ruleReview: Once approved you can create events. Each one is checked before it goes live.
apply.ruleFree: Events on Wanted Level are free to attend.

orgName.label: Organization or venue name
orgName.hint: Shown on your events, e.g. the name of your bar or association.

socialUrl.label: Website or social media page
socialUrl.hint: So we can check you're real. Starts with https://

apply.messageHint: Number of consoles, how many people fit, who's in charge on the night…
apply.publicVenue: I confirm this is a public venue (not a private home) and I'm allowed to organize events there.

event.newLead: Your event is checked by a moderator before it appears on the map.
event.fixErrors: Some fields need a fix. They're marked below.
event.editPublishedWarning: This event is live. Saving changes sends it back for review and hides it from the map until a moderator checks it again. People already going keep their spot.
event.title: Title
event.descriptionHint: What should people know? Food, drinks, house rules, bring your own controller…
event.endTimeHint: If it ends after midnight, just pick the time: we'll put it on the next day.
event.minAgeHint: Serving alcohol? 16+ for beer and wine, 18+ for spirits.
event.publicVenue: I confirm this is a public venue, the event is free to attend and open to anyone who meets the minimum age.
event.reviewNote: You'll get an email once it's published.

account.title: Your account
account.localeSaved: Language saved. We'll email you in this language too.
account.bannedNotice: Your account is suspended: you can't RSVP, post, report or host events. You can still delete your account below.
account.profilePrivacy: Your display name is only shown on group boards, to people going to the same event. There are no public profiles.
account.socialUrlHint: Only you and moderators can see this.

account.organizerApply: Want to host a launch night? Apply here
account.deleteBody: This deletes your account right away: your profile, date of birth, RSVPs, group board posts and organizer applications. If you're an organizer, your venues and events go too and people going are told. This can't be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: Yes, delete my account and all my data.
account.deleteError: Something went wrong deleting your account. Please try again or email us.

rulesPage.title: Community & safety rules
rulesPage.beforeRsvp: Before your first RSVP: please read these rules and accept them at the bottom of the page.
rulesPage.unchecked: Tick the box to accept the rules.
rulesPage.failed: Couldn't save that. Please try again.
rulesPage.loginToAccept: Log in to accept the rules.
rulesPage.checkbox: I've read the community & safety rules and I'll follow them.

organizer.title: Hosting
organizer.pitchBody: Lots of people won't have a PS5 or Xbox on launch night. If you run a bar, gaming café or student room in Antwerp, open your doors and put your event on the map.
organizer.pitchVenues: Public venues only: bars, cafés, gaming cafés, student association rooms.
organizer.pitchReview: We check every organizer and every event before it goes live.
organizer.pitchFree: Free to list, free to attend.
organizer.applied: Thanks! Your application is in. You'll get an email when a moderator has looked at it.
organizer.applicationPending: Your application as {name} is waiting for review.
organizer.saved: Saved and sent for review. You'll get an email when it's published.
organizer.cancelled: The event is cancelled. People who were going have been emailed.
organizer.banned: Your account is suspended, so you can't create or edit events.
organizer.noEvents: No events yet. Create your first launch night!
organizer.noVenues: You'll add your venue when you create your first event.

mfa.title: Two-factor check
mfa.verifyLead: Admin tools need a code from your authenticator app.
mfa.enrollLead: Admins must use an authenticator app (TOTP). Set it up once, then enter a code every time you log in.
mfa.invalid: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try the newest code.
mfa.enrollFailed: Couldn't start the setup. Try again.
mfa.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (for example Aegis, 2FAS, Google Authenticator or 1Password).
mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:

admin.title: Moderation
admin.done: Done. It's logged, and the person affected got an email.
admin.reason: Reason (logged and emailed to the person affected)
admin.reasonHint: Be specific and factual. Don't include anyone's personal details.

overview.lead: Safety reports first. Every action needs a reason and is logged.
overview.docs: Response times and message templates are in MODERATION.md; emergencies and police requests in INCIDENT.md.

reports.title: Reports
reports.lead: Safety reports are at the top. Their target is already hidden.
reports.postGone: The author has since deleted this post.

users.title: Users
users.search: Search by email, display name or user id

log.title: Moderation log
log.lead: The last 200 admin actions. This log can't be edited.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Questions, feedback, a problem with an event or your account? Email us. We usually answer within a day, faster around launch.
contact.emergencyBody: If someone is in danger, don't email us first. Call
contact.safetyTitle: Report a problem with an event or post
contact.safetyBody: Use the report button on the event or post. Safety reports hide it immediately.
contact.organizersBody: Want to host a launch night at your bar, gaming café or student room?
contact.authoritiesBody: Official requests about an event or user: email us from an official address with a reference number. We only share data through proper legal channels.
contact.privacyBody: Questions about your data or your rights? Email us, or delete your account yourself in your account settings.
contact.nonAffiliation: Wanted Level is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
